LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction01.label: Clan
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction01.description: A small but strong community of blood-related people. For them, traditions and ancestors' memory matter more than power or wealth.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction02.label: Ancient Tribe
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction02.description: A community united by a common totem and legends. They live as one, following their chieftain and spirits.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction03.label: Tribe
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction03.description: A stable structure with a clear hierarchy. Everyone knows their place, and the tribe's honor is above all.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction04.label: Community
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction04.description: A group where equality and mutual aid rule. Decisions are made collectively, like in a family.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction05.label: Gatherers
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction05.description: Nomads living on nature's gifts. They believe the world feeds those who are not greedy.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction06.label: Hunters
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction06.description: Skilled trackers and fighters who honor the law of the hunt. Their life is endless pursuit and waiting.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction07.label: Keepers
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction07.description: Guardians of ancient knowledge, sacred places, and relics. They see themselves as the link between past and future.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction08.label: Ancestors
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction08.description: Spirits or legendary founders of peoples. Their names are spoken in rituals, asking for wisdom and protection.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction09.label: Herds
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction09.description: A primitive alliance guided by instincts. The strength of each lies in merging with the mass, with nature's rhythm.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction10.label: Wanderers
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction10.description: Eternal travelers who left home for the horizon. They carry memories of foreign lands.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction11.label: Comrades
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction11.description: Those bound not by blood, but by choice. Their unity is born from a shared path and brotherhood.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction12.label: Children of Mist
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction12.description: Mysterious nomads appearing from nowhere and vanishing into haze. It is said they see what is hidden from others.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction13.label: People of Stone
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction13.description: Strong, resilient highlanders. Their life is slow, but unbreakable, like the rocks among which they live.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction14.label: Battle Clan
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction14.description: A warrior brotherhood born from war. Their creed is honor, strength, and memory of the fallen.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction15.label: Wind Wanderers
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction15.description: Spirited travelers who value freedom above all laws. Their steps leave no trace.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction16.label: Ancient Community
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction16.description: A group that has survived centuries, whose roots are lost in time. They guard forgotten rituals.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction17.label: Tree Tribe
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction17.description: A people living in unity with the forest. Their life is a cycle of growth, death, and rebirth.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction18.label: Death Tribe
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction18.description: Dark servants of the passage between worlds. They do not fear the end, seeing it as part of the journey.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction19.label: Fate Tribe
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction19.description: Prophets and seers walking the path drawn by stars. They believe every living being has a destiny.
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction20.label: Spirit Tribe
LanguageData.DF_NeolithicFaction20.description: Beings living on the border of worlds. Their voice is the whisper of the wind, and their presence is felt when darkness thickens.
